verdict.rationale: Checkout.com ships official SDKs: a first-party GitHub repo for the official Node.js SDK, plus documented native iOS and Android Mobile SDKs (Flow for Mobile). Developers can build server-side and mobile integrations against vendor-maintained libraries. Missing for 10: evidence of server SDKs beyond Node.js (e.g. Python, Java, .NET), in-depth SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
